items.title: Coach does it for you
items.body: Tell Coach you drank water, ate, how you feel, or to move, skip or swap today's workout. Undo any time.

items.title: Coach logs your measurements
items.body: Say "weight is now 66" or "waist 82 cm" and it's saved, with Undo.

items.title: Close a custom session any time
items.body: What you added stays. Resume it from Train.

items.title: See when your moves were updated
items.body: Settings → HD animations shows the pack date, last check and update. Train shows a pill while new moves download.
